visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor living room. A father wearing a black t-shirt and glasses is sitting at a low table, eating skewers. Next to him, a young boy in a striped shirt is also eating. A baby in a light-colored jumpsuit crawls on the floor to the left. The room is tidy with a grey sofa and various child-related items. (2) The young boy takes a large bite of food and suddenly stops chewing, his face turning pale and distressed. The father notices immediately, stops eating, and leans in to inspect the boy's mouth, showing growing alarm. (3) The father quickly pulls the boy away from the table and begins performing the Heimlich maneuver. He stands behind the boy, wrapping his arms around the boy's torso and applying forceful upward thrusts. His facial expression is one of intense focus and panic. (4) A mother wearing a pink oversized sweatshirt runs into the frame from a hallway in the background, looking extremely worried. She approaches the father and son as the father finishes the maneuver. The boy stands by the table, appearing shocked but breathing, while the father checks his mouth again. (5) The parents stand together by the table, comforting the child and checking his condition. A ginger cat walks across the background hallway. The baby continues to crawl and play on the floor, oblivious to the situation.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The father is wearing a black t-shirt and glasses. The young boy is wearing a horizontal striped long-sleeved shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern home living room with a grey fabric sofa, a white wall with a hexagonal shelf, various children's toys, and a light-colored play mat on the floor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with the father's calm conversational voice accompanied by light acoustic guitar music. Ambient sounds of eating and soft background movement are present. The speech rate is moderate and tone is friendly. (2) A sudden increase in vocal tension occurs as the father shouts commands to 'spit it out.' The pitch and intensity rise sharply. The background music continues but is partially masked by the urgent speech. (3) Rapid thumping and rustling sounds of clothing are heard as the father moves to perform the maneuver. He yells a name loudly with high arousal. The music persists, creating a jarring juxtaposition with the emergency. (4) The mother's voice enters, exhibiting very high pitch and frantic arousal. There is significant overlapping speech as both parents check on the boy. The music continues its steady rhythm as the intensity of the shouting begins to subside into concerned questioning.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Normalcy -> Incident -> Emergency Response -> Recovery
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a real-life domestic emergency where a young boy chokes on food while eating with his father. It serves as a stark reminder of the dangers of choking and demonstrates the successful application of the Heimlich maneuver in a high-stress situation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is a personal record of an emergency event; the Cubo logo appears to be from a home security/baby monitor camera used to record the footage.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The contrast between the cheerful background music and the life-threatening situation creates a high level of emotional tension. The use of CCTV-style footage adds to the authenticity.
